name: Product Coherence and No-Dead-End Workflow Architecture
purpose: Keep NetCoin from feeling like disconnected mini-apps by assigning every surface to a product lens, a user job, a primary workflow, and a next action.
north_star: Every NetCoin screen answers: where am I, what job am I doing, what is the one primary action, can I trust this state, and what happens next?

product_lenses.label: NetCoin
product_lenses.promise: Manage NET, understand chain activity, and participate safely.

product_lenses.label: NetCoin Network
product_lenses.promise: Operate, observe, and recover network infrastructure.

product_lenses.label: NetCoin Studio
product_lenses.promise: Build, verify, document, and audit NetCoin releases.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Payment request created. Incoming transactions can be verified in Explorer.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: The address was not changed. Retry receive or open Wallet settings.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Transaction sent. Explorer opened with the broadcast transaction.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: Nothing was broadcast. Review recipient, balance, fee, and node status.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Result verified against the active indexed chain.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: No chain data changed. Search another hash, address, or block.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Order submitted. Position and settlement rules are visible.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: No order was placed. Review liquidity, fee, lifecycle state, and max loss.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Claim submitted. Wallet and Explorer can track the transaction.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: No claim was sent. Check cooldown, funding, and abuse challenge state.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Withdrawal moved to the next custody state and remains auditable.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: Funds were not broadcast. Review approval, limits, signer, and ledger reconciliation.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Incident state changed and the next runbook step is visible.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: No operator state was changed. Export diagnostics or open the linked runbook.

workflow_evidence.success_reassurance: Release verified. It is safe to continue with installation for this testnet package.
workflow_evidence.failure_recovery: Do not install. Re-download, compare signatures, or inspect provenance.

no_dead_end_rules: Every page must define one owner job and one primary action.
Every empty state must offer one next action.
Every error state must offer a recovery action and a reassurance sentence.
Every success state must offer a verification link or next workflow step.
Every advanced-only area must link back to the simple workflow it supports.
Every operator/developer surface must be reachable from a lens, not primary public navigation.
Every workflow must end in Explorer, Wallet, Portfolio, Ledger, Runbook, Install, or Blocked state.
Every new page must prove why a panel, drawer, section, or existing surface cannot handle the job.
success_criteria: A first-time user can identify Wallet, Explorer, and Markets as the main public product in under 30 seconds.
No page can pass validation without one owner job, one primary action, one trust signal, and one next step.
Operator and developer tools are organized under NetCoin Network or NetCoin Studio instead of competing with public navigation.
Every irreversible or trust-critical workflow has a success reassurance and failure recovery message.
Every major workflow avoids dead ends by ending in a verification, recovery, or next-workflow state.
Future features must improve an existing workflow, remove a ceiling, increase trust/safety/clarity, or reduce complexity.
